description: This source file defines the 'ThingsAggregatorProxyActor' class, an Akka actor in Java that acts as a proxy for aggregating things in the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles incoming retrieve requests, interacts with target actors to fetch Thing data (via SourceRef), processes the streaming responses, and returns assembled responses. The class includes methods for handling different request types, processing streams, and managing responses, with detailed logging and metrics.

classes.name: ThingsAggregatorProxyActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class that proxies aggregation requests for 'Things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework, managing request handling, stream-based responses, and error handling.

classes.name: PlainJson
